description: This file defines classes, constants, and functions related to Flight Recorder for distributed training in PyTorch, including a DebugInfoWriter class, a template FlightRecorder class, and functions for dumping trace information.

classes.name: DebugInfoWriter
classes.description: Abstract class for writing debug info related to NCCL and distributed training.

classes.name: FlightRecorder
classes.description: Template class for recording and managing distributed training events and traces.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Virtual method to write trace information.

methods.name: getWriter
methods.description: Static method to get the singleton writer instance for a given rank.

methods.name: registerWriter
methods.description: Static method to register a custom DebugInfoWriter.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Static method to get the singleton instance of FlightRecorder.

methods.name: FlightRecorder
methods.description: Constructor initializing the recorder with buffer size and stack capture settings.

methods.name: recordWithResetEnabled
methods.description: Records an event with reset capability, returning a TraceIdentifier.

methods.name: record
methods.description: Records an event, returning an optional index.

methods.name: retire_id
methods.description: Marks an event as completed and optionally computes its duration.

methods.name: dump_json
methods.description: Returns a JSON string of the current trace data.
